data.notes: June 2026 in Amsterdam is already anchored by major outdoor electronic festivals, jazz and roots programming, and a run of large Ziggo Dome arena shows.

events.title: KAYTRANADA - EUROPE '26 TOUR
events.summary: KAYTRANADA plays Ziggo Dome on 1 June 2026 with Uncle Waffles listed on the bill. The Amsterdam date is part of his Europe '26 Tour.

events.title: Holland Festival 2026
events.summary: The 79th Holland Festival runs from 3 to 28 June 2026 with 30 productions and 104 performances across 23 venues. Composer and musician Hildur Guðnadóttir is the 2026 associate artist, with music-led projects including Chernobyl, Where To From, Nærmynd and Passing Remark.

events.title: Red Light Jazz 2026
events.summary: Red Light Jazz 2026 runs across 5, 6 and 7 June with performances throughout Amsterdam's Red Light District. The listed programme includes artists such as Mark Beebe Trio, ACHHA, Chocos and Red Light Jazz Dinner feat. DJ + New Cool Collective.

events.title: 909 Festival 2026
events.summary: 909 Festival returns to Amsterdamse Bos on 6 and 7 June 2026. Confirmed names include Adam Beyer, Anfisa Letyago, Fjaak x KiNK live, Mall Grab, Ben Böhmer live, Eric Prydz, Jeff Mills and Kevin Saunderson.

events.title: Amsterdam Open Air 2026
events.summary: Amsterdam Open Air is confirmed at Gaasperpark on 6 and 7 June 2026. The city listing describes the two-day festival as a reflection of Amsterdam nightlife, spanning house, techno, disco, hip-hop and electro.

events.title: FKA twigs: BODY HIGH TOUR
events.summary: FKA twigs brings the BODY HIGH TOUR to Ziggo Dome on 6 June 2026. Yves Tumor is listed as support on the Ticketmaster event page.

events.title: DJ Bone presents: FURTHER 6th Anniversary
events.summary: DJ Bone's FURTHER marks its 6th anniversary at RADION on 6 June 2026. The RA listing confirms DJ Bone b2b Zack Fox, Ellaweeez and residents for a 23:00-07:00 night session.

events.title: Iron Maiden - Run For Your Live World Tour 2026
events.summary: Iron Maiden plays Ziggo Dome on 10 June 2026 on the Run For Your Live World Tour 2026. Evergrey is confirmed as support.

events.title: Doja Cat - Tour Ma Vie World Tour
events.summary: Doja Cat performs at Ziggo Dome on 12 June 2026 as part of the Tour Ma Vie World Tour. Ticketmaster lists the Amsterdam concert at 20:00.

events.title: Guns N' Roses - World Tour 2026
events.summary: Guns N' Roses have two confirmed Ziggo Dome shows on 18 and 20 June 2026. Mammoth is listed on the lineup for the Amsterdam dates.

events.title: Mystic Garden: Echo's of Amsterdam
events.summary: Mystic Garden lists Echo's of Amsterdam for 20 June 2026 at Sloterpark, Amsterdam. The event is presented as its summer edition, with tickets on sale via the official site.

events.title: Amsterdam Roots Festival 2026
events.summary: Amsterdam Roots Festival is confirmed for 28 June 2026 from 13:00 to 23:00. The City of Amsterdam describes it as an event where artists and makers from around the world share cultural backgrounds through music, dance, circus and theatre.
